requirements.risk: Account labels can overwrite newer human input, retarget another account or inadvertently alter connection/credential authority.

scenarios.given: Closed owned metadata input
scenarios.when: Parse wrong actor/account, extra authority, malformed revisions and labels
scenarios.then: Accept exactly the original closed row; refuse every foreign or invalid shape.
tests: account-metadata.test.mjs#account metadata rejects foreign identities extra authority and invalid revisions

scenarios.given: A captured principal/account/revision and current CSRF bootstrap
scenarios.when: Read and save a display name
scenarios.then: Use only the owned same-origin path, actor, CSRF and expected revision with bounded lifetime; refuse mismatched acknowledgments.
tests: account-metadata.test.mjs#metadata transport binds the owned account actor csrf and exact observed revision

scenarios.given: An original loaded name with a delayed write acknowledgment
scenarios.when: Edit again and attempt another save before completion
scenarios.then: Send exactly one write at the captured revision; accept its exact acknowledgment while retaining the newer unsent local text.
tests: account-metadata.test.mjs#one pending rename preserves edits made before its exact acknowledgment arrives

scenarios.given: A stale label write and another tab newer name
scenarios.when: Reload, review and explicitly keep local text before saving
scenarios.then: Retain local input, block blind retry, show newest readback, require human review and then send only the newly observed revision.
tests: account-metadata.test.mjs#conflict readback keeps local text until explicit review before another save

scenarios.given: A server save with lost response, or malformed/foreign/wrong-revision acknowledgment
scenarios.when: Attempt save and later read back
scenarios.then: Preserve input and old acknowledged metadata, stop automatic retry, and accept current saved state only after explicit readback/review.
tests: account-metadata.test.mjs#lost or malformed save acknowledgments retain input and never automatically retry

scenarios.given: A mounted original principal with delayed read or CSRF bootstrap
scenarios.when: Close that controller before completion
scenarios.then: Publish no late result and send no POST after disposal; state remains closed.
tests: account-metadata.test.mjs#closing a principal during delayed reads or csrf bootstrap cannot publish or send a write

scenarios.given: A clean original name or local input queued while a read is pending
scenarios.when: Explicitly reload a changed saved name
scenarios.then: A clean input adopts the acknowledged saved name; newer local text remains and a changed server value requires explicit conflict review.
tests: account-metadata.test.mjs#explicit reload follows a changed saved name without replacing newer local input

scenarios.then: stale model context and a connection changed during csrf bootstrap send zero writes; actual saved/current context, request body/write counts and retained intention are asserted independently.

scenarios.given: Native Chrome independently reproduces TypeError for fetch called with a controller receiver, while an unbound transport succeeds

requirements.risk: Bookkeeping could display foreign or draft balances, falsely accept a changed journal, or post an unreviewed payload.

scenarios.given: A synthetic owned exact0.30 journal, fixed hashes and explicit authenticated transport responses.
scenarios.when: proposal acknowledgment must match the exact requested journal content
scenarios.then: A changed description in a journal acknowledgment is rejected even with the original operation UUID.
tests: bookkeeping.test.mjs#proposal acknowledgment must match the exact requested journal content

scenarios.given: A synthetic owned exact0.30 journal, fixed hashes and explicit authenticated transport responses.
scenarios.when: ledger snapshots reject stale actors mixed book revisions and foreign account rows
scenarios.then: Original snapshots pass; stale actors, mixed revisions and journal accounts from another book refuse.
tests: bookkeeping.test.mjs#ledger snapshots reject stale actors mixed book revisions and foreign account rows

scenarios.given: A synthetic owned exact0.30 journal, fixed hashes and explicit authenticated transport responses.
scenarios.when: posting sends exact human review hash and rejects unconfirmed or foreign receipts
scenarios.then: Only the exact journal/hash/current revision is posted using CSRF and original actor; foreign actor/hash/revision/state receipts refuse.
tests: bookkeeping.test.mjs#posting sends exact human review hash and rejects unconfirmed or foreign receipts

scenarios.given: A synthetic owned exact0.30 journal, fixed hashes and explicit authenticated transport responses.
scenarios.when: decimal display preserves large and four-decimal amounts without float rounding
scenarios.then: Large decimal and four-place values display exactly without floating rounding; nonfinite and exponent strings refuse.
tests: bookkeeping.test.mjs#decimal display preserves large and four-decimal amounts without float rounding

scenarios.given: A synthetic owned exact0.30 journal, fixed hashes and explicit authenticated transport responses.
scenarios.when: book components accept stable references and reject invented data authority or repeated controls
scenarios.then: Stable book UUID components pass; supplied rows, foreign reference and duplicate control reject.
tests: bookkeeping.test.mjs#book components accept stable references and reject invented data authority or repeated controls

scenarios.given: An account activity reply with a negative running balance, plus foreign, inconsistent or malformed variants
scenarios.when: Read and parse account activity
scenarios.then: Accept only the exact bound book/account reply, display signed balances without float arithmetic, send an actor-bound GET, and reject foreign, inconsistent, negative-zero, short-decimal, extra-field or path-like input before any request.
tests: bookkeeping.test.mjs#account activity keeps exact signed balances and rejects foreign or inconsistent rows

scenarios.given: A statement file, a consistent imported-row reply, and unsafe names, empty or oversized content or inconsistent replies
scenarios.when: Import a statement and parse imported rows
scenarios.then: Send the exact content, filename and observed revision with the actor binding; accept only consistent rows for this book; refuse unsafe, empty or oversized files before any request and refuse foreign or inconsistent replies.
tests: bookkeeping.test.mjs#statement import sends exact bounded content with the observed revision and parses only consistent rows

scenarios.given: Book snapshots with a close date, a malformed close date and a missing close field
scenarios.when: Parse the snapshot
scenarios.then: Accept a valid close date and reject malformed or missing ones.
tests: bookkeeping.test.mjs#books carry an optional close date and reject a malformed one

scenarios.given: A balanced report, a loss, and unbalanced, mis-categorised, extra-field, wrong-range or wrong-book replies
scenarios.when: Read and parse financial statements
scenarios.then: Accept the exact report and a negative net income; reject every inconsistent reply; send an actor-bound GET for the exact range and refuse a malformed date before any request.
tests: bookkeeping.test.mjs#financial statements are accepted only for this book and range and only when they balance

scenarios.given: A ledger snapshot whose asset account is marked bank or cash, and ones with a non-boolean mark or a mark on a non-asset account
scenarios.when: Parse the snapshot
scenarios.then: Accept the boolean mark on the asset account; refuse a non-boolean mark and a mark on any other category.
tests: bookkeeping.test.mjs#accounts may carry a bank-or-cash flag only as a boolean and only on asset accounts

scenarios.given: A financial report and an account history whose accounts carry the bank-or-cash flag, and ones with a non-boolean flag, a flag on an income account or an unknown field
scenarios.when: Parse them
scenarios.then: Accept the flagged report and history unchanged; refuse the non-boolean flag, the flag on a non-asset account and the unknown field.
tests: bookkeeping.test.mjs#report and activity rows accept the server bank-or-cash flag and still refuse unknown fields

scenarios.given: A book with one marked bank account and one unmarked asset account, and import acknowledgments and rows with matching, missing or malformed account references
scenarios.when: Import a statement naming an account and parse the rows
scenarios.then: Send the named marked account exactly; refuse an unmarked or unknown account before any request; accept only an acknowledgment naming the same account, and only rows whose account reference is a UUID or null.
tests: bookkeeping.test.mjs#a statement import names only a marked bank account and accepts only the matching acknowledgment and rows

scenarios.given: Statement rows settled by a match, by their own entry and still pending, and rows with a missing, unknown or inconsistent settlement
scenarios.when: Parse the rows
scenarios.then: Accept match, entry and pending rows as given; refuse a settled row without how it was settled, an unknown value, a pending row claiming a match, a settled row without an entry, and a row without the field.
tests: bookkeeping.test.mjs#statement rows say how they were settled and reject an inconsistent settlement

scenarios.given: A statement row marked as a repeat of another row, and rows whose repeat mark is missing, malformed, self-referencing or combined with an entry or another state
scenarios.when: Parse the rows
scenarios.then: Accept the repeat naming the other row with no entry; refuse every inconsistent combination and a row without the field.
tests: bookkeeping.test.mjs#a repeated statement line names the line it repeats and has no entry

requirements.risk: The person approves something other than what is shown, or a decision is reported that the server did not make.

scenarios.given: An approval list reply and foreign, duplicated, unknown-operation or extra-field variants
scenarios.when: Read and parse approvals
scenarios.then: Accept only this actor's consistent pending and decided requests with an actor-bound GET; reject every variant.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#approval list accepts only this actor and consistent pending and decided requests

scenarios.given: A reviewed pending request and matching, failed, mismatched or undecided acknowledgments
scenarios.when: Approve or reject it
scenarios.then: Send exactly the decision and reviewed hash; accept approved or failed outcomes for this request and reject mismatched, undecided or contradictory replies.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#one decision sends the reviewed hash and rejects a mismatched or undecided acknowledgment

scenarios.given: A batch of two reviewed requests and complete or incomplete acknowledgments
scenarios.when: Approve the batch
scenarios.then: Send exactly the reviewed hashes for that batch; require every item decided; refuse mixed batches.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a batch decision sends exactly the reviewed hashes and requires every item decided

scenarios.given: Pending requests in and out of a batch with server-read entry lines and markup in a description
scenarios.when: Build and render approval cards
scenarios.then: Group batches, show the entry lines without raw markup, warn when the target changed, and render Approve/Reject through the published Fancy approval card only while pending.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#cards group batches, show server-read entry lines and render through the Fancy approval card

scenarios.given: Approved, failed and rejected outcomes with markup in a summary, an empty list and a still-pending request
scenarios.when: Build the note sent to the agent after a decision
scenarios.then: State each outcome exactly with markup neutralised and ask the agent to continue; produce no note when nothing was decided.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#the note sent after a decision states exact outcomes and is empty when nothing was decided

scenarios.given: A picked CSV within limits and text, oversized, empty, restored, path-like or malformed attachments
scenarios.when: Check a message before sending
scenarios.then: Allow only up to three picked CSV files within 512 KB; refuse the rest with a remove-them message; the note names each stored file exactly.
tests: chat-drafts.test.mjs#only picked CSV files within the size limit can be sent, and the note names each stored file

scenarios.given: A file upload and exact, mismatched, content-echoing or refused acknowledgments
scenarios.when: Upload an attached file
scenarios.then: Send the name and content with the actor binding; accept only the acknowledgment for that exact name and size; reject the others.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#an attached file is uploaded for this actor and only its exact acknowledgment is accepted

scenarios.given: A pending reversal request with server-read opposite lines
scenarios.when: Parse it and build its card
scenarios.then: Accept the reversal operation, show the opposite lines, state that the original entry is kept, and title the card as a reversal.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a reversal card shows the opposite lines and says the original entry is kept

scenarios.given: Pending requests to close, fully reopen and partly reopen the books
scenarios.when: Build their cards
scenarios.then: State exactly what closing does and that history is unchanged; state the current and new close dates for reopening; accept both operations.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#period cards say exactly what closing or reopening does

scenarios.given: A pending opening balance request with an offset line, one whose figures balance, and one that can no longer be built
scenarios.when: Build their cards
scenarios.then: Show every line and the totals; state the supplied totals and that the difference goes to opening balance equity, or that nothing does; say plainly when approving will fail.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#an opening balance card shows every line, the totals and what goes to opening balance equity

scenarios.given: Pending requests to mark and to unmark a bank or cash account, and one whose account is gone
scenarios.when: Build their cards
scenarios.then: Name the account and books, say whether it will or will no longer count as a bank account or cash on hand and that no amounts change; say plainly when approving will fail.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a bank or cash account card names the account and says no amounts change

scenarios.given: Pending statement import requests with and without a named bank account
scenarios.when: Build their cards
scenarios.then: Name the bank account the statement is from when one is given, and omit it otherwise; keep the size, books and no-entries-posted wording.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a statement import card names the bank account the statement is from when one is given

scenarios.given: An Excel statement of eight bytes, acknowledgments naming another file, another size or extra fields, empty and oversized files, and server refusals by code
scenarios.when: Send the workbook
scenarios.then: Send the exact bytes as base64 for this actor; accept only the matching acknowledgment; never send empty or oversized files; turn each refusal code into a plain instruction naming the row or the problem.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#an Excel statement is sent as its exact bytes and a refusal says what to fix

scenarios.given: A picked .xlsx statement, and .xls, .xlsm and .ods files, an oversized workbook, a pick whose bytes cannot be read and a path-like name
scenarios.when: Check whether the message can be sent
scenarios.then: The .xlsx statement can be sent alongside a CSV; every other pick is refused with the CSV-or-Excel instruction.
tests: chat-drafts.test.mjs#a picked Excel statement can be sent as bytes; other spreadsheet formats and unreadable picks cannot

scenarios.given: Summaries of about 450 and of 600 characters, a summary containing markup characters, and a 300-character fact from the server
scenarios.when: Build the card
scenarios.then: Show the 450-character summary whole; cut only at the 500-character server limit; replace markup characters with spaces; keep other facts at their 200-character bound.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a long summary is shown whole up to the server limit, with markup characters made inert

scenarios.given: A reconciled PDF import request showing two of three rows, the same for a CSV with all rows, and an import without balances
scenarios.when: Build their cards
scenarios.then: Show each row with markup inert, the count of rows not shown, the opening balance plus rows equals closing balance line, and a check-the-PDF note only for a PDF; show no balance line without balances.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a reconciled statement card shows the rows, both balances and a check-the-PDF note

scenarios.given: A PDF of four bytes and of 600 KB, one over 700 KB, a 600 KB workbook, and scanned or unreadable PDF refusals
scenarios.when: Send the file
scenarios.then: Send PDFs as exact bytes up to 700 KB; never send an oversized PDF or a workbook over its own limit; say plainly that a scanned PDF has no readable text.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a PDF statement is sent as bytes up to its own limit and its refusals say what to do

scenarios.given: A picked 650 KB PDF, one over 700 KB, a pick whose bytes cannot be read, a .docx and a 650 KB workbook
scenarios.when: Check whether the message can be sent
scenarios.then: The PDF can be sent as bytes; each other pick is refused with the instruction naming both limits.
tests: chat-drafts.test.mjs#a picked PDF statement can be sent as bytes up to 700 KB; larger or unreadable picks cannot

scenarios.given: A pending request to match a savings statement line to a draft transfer entry, the same with a posted entry, and one whose records are gone
scenarios.when: Build their cards
scenarios.then: Show the statement line with its bank account, the entry with its state and lines, and that the line is settled without a second entry and no amounts change; say plainly when approving will fail.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a match card shows the statement line, the entry and its lines, and says nothing is booked twice

scenarios.given: A pending request to mark a statement line as a repeat of a line on another statement, and one whose lines are gone
scenarios.when: Build their cards
scenarios.then: Show the bank account and both lines side by side with statement, date, description and amount; say the line gets no entry and to reject if they were two transactions; say plainly when approving will fail.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a duplicate card shows both lines side by side and how to refuse a false duplicate

scenarios.given: A pending request to tie a two-line statement to Checking, the same for a one-line statement already tied, and one whose records are gone
scenarios.when: Build their cards
scenarios.then: Name the statement, its line count, the books and the account, say existing entries agree and nothing changes; warn when it is already tied or cannot be found.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a statement account card names the statement, its lines and the account, and warns when it is stale

scenarios.given: Pending requests to add a statement's balances and to record a reconciliation; the same when the statement already has balances, no longer agrees, or cannot be found
scenarios.when: Build their cards
scenarios.then: Show the opening plus lines equals closing figures, or the bank, books, unposted, outstanding and difference figures; say nothing changes when current, and that approving will fail when stale or missing.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#balance and reconciliation cards show the exact figures and say when approving will fail

scenarios.given: A pending discard request with the draft lines read by the server, the same request once the entry is no longer a draft, and an unknown operation name
scenarios.when: Parse and render them
scenarios.then: The discard is accepted with its title and lines with markup inert, saying nothing was posted and the statement line becomes pending; a stale one says approving will fail; the unknown operation is refused.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a discard card shows the draft lines and says nothing was posted

scenarios.given: Requests to set up and to stop a recurring entry, with and without an end date, already stopped, and no longer valid
scenarios.when: Parse and render their cards
scenarios.then: The set-up card shows the lines, amount, day and range and says nothing posts by itself; the stop card says existing entries are kept; stale and invalid requests say approving will fail; markup is inert.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a recurring entry card shows the lines, the day and that each month still needs approval

scenarios.given: An accrual request with its lines and dates, and one no longer valid
scenarios.when: Parse and render its card
scenarios.then: The card has its title, the exact lines with markup inert, and says the entry posts on one date and its exact opposite on the other; the invalid one says approving will fail.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#an accrual card shows the lines and both dates

scenarios.given: Requests to schedule and to stop a workflow: daily, weekly, monthly, no longer valid, already stopped and not found
scenarios.when: Parse and render their cards
scenarios.then: The schedule card names the workflow, version, timetable in UTC and first run, and says runs start by themselves once per time, keep the approved version, stop when access is removed and cannot change the books; the stop card says started runs are not changed; invalid, stopped and missing ones say approving will fail; markup is inert.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a scheduled workflow card says what starts, when, and that it runs by itself

scenarios.given: A request to release statements with its totals, one no longer valid and one without totals
scenarios.when: Parse and render its card
scenarios.then: The card shows the books, title, range, release number and each key figure, and says the statements are kept as they stand, no entry changes and the release is never rewritten; the invalid ones say approving will fail; markup is inert.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a statement release card shows the period, the key figures and that the release is kept as it is

scenarios.given: Requests to group businesses and to remove a group, and ones no longer valid
scenarios.when: Parse and render their cards
scenarios.then: The card names each business and the currency and says no entry changes and that amounts between the businesses are not removed yet; the removal card says the books are not touched; invalid ones say approving will fail; markup is inert.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a group card names the businesses and says combined figures are not eliminated

scenarios.given: A request to leave accounts out of a group's consolidated totals, one with an empty list and one no longer valid
scenarios.when: Parse and render its card
scenarios.then: The card lists each account with its business and kind and says no entry changes and that a one-sided dealing is shown as a difference; an empty list says nothing is left out any more; an invalid one says approving will fail; markup is inert.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#an elimination card lists each account by business and says nothing in the books changes

scenarios.given: Requests to set a cash account aside and to release it, one already in the asked state and one no longer valid
scenarios.when: Parse and render its card
scenarios.then: The card names the account, books and balance and says the money stays in the books but is left out of usable cash, or counts again when released, and that no entry changes; requests that would fail say so; markup is inert.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a restricted cash card says the money stays in the books but is left out of usable cash

scenarios.given: Requests to add repeating, one-off and what-if planned items and to remove one, and ones no longer valid
scenarios.when: Parse and render their cards
scenarios.then: The card says what is planned, whether money comes in or goes out, the amount, date, repeat and end; a what-if says it counts only when asked about; it says the item is a plan, not an entry, and that books, balances and statements do not change; invalid ones say approving will fail; markup is inert.
tests: approvals.test.mjs#a cash plan card says what is planned, when, and that the books do not change
